02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE ENDPOINTS

I like the part
you don’t see.

The logic that holds everything together. The request that comes back a little faster. The system that makes someone’s day easier.

I started coding in 2020 and began my professional engineering journey in 2023. Today, I work mainly with PHP/Laravel and Java/Spring Boot, connecting product ideas to the systems that make them possible.
